body: When your schedule is already stretched to its absolute limit, one unexpected schedule change or sudden cancellation can feel like the final straw that brings the whole house down. When the Moon squares Uranus, emotional tension and sudden disruption lock horns, making a minor inconvenience hit with the force of a catastrophe. The friction is usually exposing how little operational flexibility you had left, not proving that your entire path is broken. Fix the immediate pressure point before you blow up the structures that were actually working.
